The Council were not blind to the Schryke's intentions. They sensed the envoy's indifference with their response, what was to follow was obvious. The Schrykes would undoubtedly begin to try to establish a presence, here within Sentenza's sphere of influence. This intrusion on their homeland would be unwelcome, to say the least. Something had to be done.

There were many other things that were obvious, the Schrykes are highly militaristic, to a degree that the Spectra were not. They employed solders to speak on their behalf, not diplomats. To oppose the Schrykes was to invite violence to their home. If war was to be avoided, then the spectra would have to make war an undesirable outcome for all parties. However, it was always unwise to be unprepared. They were currently incapable of warfare, that had to change. Freedom in an uncaring world was hard to ensure, unless you had a blade to protect it.

The Order of Contemplation called for Quadrivus. They required his assistance, a group of workers, resolute in purpose, unwavering in their certainty. What they needed was the creation of a weapon, a simple weapon to start. They showed the fruits of Phaedrus's research. Take the moderate control mechanism developed for the floatstone, and use it to create a projectile capable of accelerating in mid air, increasing the range and eliminating the need to manually launch the projectile. This undertaking would occur deep within the Hall of Flux, away from prying eyes. This would be the first measure that would be required. When time came, Sentenza must protect itself.

Secondly, the Order visited the Crystal Tower, and using it, broadcast a thought to the ambassadors to the Fulcrid, and to a scouting party near the Deva.

To the Fulcrid Spiders, a quiet plea was sent. As one leader of a sovereign nation to another, we mus acknowledge each other's claims to the neighboring lands. It was a mutual acknowledgement of the Spheres of Influence of the other party, as well as claimed land for expansion. If these claims were disputed by an outside party, the two parties will act in defense of the claims of the other. A defensive pact, of sorts, was offered to the Fulcrid.

To the Deva, a separate proposal was made. Pool together our strengths and ingenuity to enhance progress and innovation. A research agreement between two nations. Create a stable base to lay the seeds of future relations.

The requests were sent, it would have been a safe, and prudent move regardless of circumstance. After all, it was much too difficult to start up alone in an uncaring world. Sometimes, you might need friends by your side.

Offers would be made, and perhaps even accepted. Either way, the Spectra could only look forwards to a dark and uncertain future. It would not do to be stifled by the Schrykes in the infancy of the young nation. It was time, perhaps, to start making preparations.
